prompt: Single continuous shot. Breadcrumbs, lemon zest and herbs tumbled together, olive oil drizzled in until the mixture clumps like wet sand between fingers in macro. The crust pressed generously onto white fillets. Money shot: out of the oven, a fork pressing through the golden crust — it shatters audibly — into snow-white flakes that separate and steam, backlit. Final beat: plated beside charred lemon halves, one squeezed, droplets flying. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the sand-clump mixing, then the crust shatter. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Peixe de forno com crosta dourada — sem cheiro na casa, sem frigideira.
🧾 4 filés de tilápia · 1 xíc. de farinha de rosca · raspas de 1 limão · 2 col. de azeite · ervas
1. Mistura farinha, raspas, ervas e azeite até virar farofa úmida. 2. Filés na assadeira, crosta apertada por cima. 3. Forno 220° por 12 min — sem virar.
💡 A crosta protege o peixe: ele assa no vapor próprio e não resseca. Salva pra sexta 📌
